# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Miraculous Honeycomb; Bees from Paradise

---

**1** 'Bring me the honeycomb,' the man said. Aseneth brought it and set it before him.

**2** The man reached out, broke off a piece of the honeycomb, placed it at Aseneth's lips, and said: 'Eat.' She ate.

**3** 'You have now eaten the bread of life,' the man said, 'drunk the cup of immortality, and been anointed with incorruptible oil. From today your flesh will bloom like flowers springing from the soil of the Most High. Your bones will be strong as the cedars of God's paradise. Unwearying powers will serve you all your days. Your youth will not age. Your beauty will never fade.'

**4** Aseneth was overjoyed to hear this.

**5** 'Do you see this honeycomb?' the man asked. 'Yes, lord,' she said. 'This comb,' he said, 'is made of the honey of paradise. The angels of God eat from it, and whoever eats of it will never die.'

**6** The man touched the honeycomb, and white bees began emerging from the cells — snow-white, with wings of violet and purple and scarlet and gold, wearing tiny golden crowns, their stings sharp as iron.

**7** The bees swarmed over Aseneth from her feet to her head. Other large bees circled her and fed from the honeycomb.

**8** The man of God said to the bees: 'Go back to your place now.' At once all the bees lifted up and flew away into the heavens.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
